All my published books so far (as of Sept 2025) ...

From the "Memories Fond" brand ...

1. "Seasons with Dad" by Andrew Abel, illustrations by Graeme Holding
Scenes through the seasons in my childhood village & beyond. Probably my best book overall.

2. "Big Bad Wolf's Birthday" written & illustrated by Andrew Abel
A humorous sequel to the classic tale, "The Three Little Pigs". My grandkids love to hear me recount this poem when trying to get to sleep.

3. "Zac is Back!" by Andrew Abel
A very funny, and zany, Christian book celebrating sharing the gospel by being a good friend. My funniest book, and a favorite with kids.

4. "Adopt a Dinosaur" by Andrew Abel
Why dinos might not make good pets. Inspired by my grandson's love for dinosaurs.

5. "Slice & Ice" by Andrew Abel
How everyone in our family likes different pizzas and ice cream. My grandkids love choosing their own pizza and ice cream from the menu at the end.

6. "I Like Earth" by Andrew Abel
A secular book on the uniqueness of Earth. Inspired by Kirk Bertche's sermon in the apologetics series

7. "Finding Granny' by Andrew Abel, illustrations by Graeme Holding
Inspired by a picture treasure hunt my father would set for his grandkids. Beloved by Grannies and young kids.

8. (Spanish). "Buscando a Abuelita" by Andrew Abel, illustrations by Graeme Holding
Spanish translation of "Finding Granny" (above). Doesn't rhyme.

9. "Walking with Dad" by Andrew Abel, illustrations by Graeme Holding
Scenes from my childhood. My most sold book.

10. "The Farmer's Crop" by Andrew Abel, illustrations by Carolyn Chaffee Lee
Christian: A retelling of the parable of the sower in rhyme. My most artistic book thanks to Carolyn.

11. "A Useless Book" by Andrew Abel - you don't learn something on every single page! A zany book with Dr Seuss-like humor.

The remaining books are my earlier works, under the "Stories with Grandpa" brand

12. "The Farmer wants his Crops to Grow" by Andrew Abel
Christian: A retelling of the Parable of the Sower in rhyme. 

13. "The Other Brother" by Andrew Abel
Christian: A retelling of the prodigal son in rhyme. 

14. "The Whale & the Worm" by Andrew Abel
Christian: A retelling of the story of Jonah in rhyme. 

15. "I'm a Champion Soccer Player" by Andrew Abel
A visualization of a humorous poem my grandad would recount to me, probably written in the 1920's.
